About the studio

A practical eye for material and mood.

I'm a ceramic and tile designer with over 10 years of experience crafting elegant, functional designs. My work blends artistry with practicality to create ceramic tiles for residential and commercial spaces.

As a designer at Zohreh Tile Factory, I develop and advertise ceramic tile collections with bold compositions and refined aesthetics. My practice also extends to 3D interior design, where I make realistic demonstrations that help clients see how porcelain tiles transform a room.

I care about design, innovation and bringing distinct concepts into the everyday. If you would like to collaborate or explore the work, please get in touch.
